title: Resilience and vulnerability in the midbrain dopamine system during aging
title_zh: 中脑多巴胺系统在衰老过程中的韧性与脆弱性
abstract: The midbrain dopamine system is integral to movement, reward, and motivation, and its dysfunction underlies a range of brain disorders. Age is a primary risk factor for many of these disorders, yet systematic analysis of how the dopamine system changes during healthy aging remains relatively understudied. In this review, we first examine the impact of healthy aging on the dopamine system across sexes and species, including flies, mice, rats, and humans. We next consider the neuroadaptive mechanisms that sustain dopamine neuron function with age. Finally, we contrast the molecular mechanisms of age-related neurodegenerative diseases with those of healthy aging, exploring the possibility that loss of neuroadaptive reserve drives dopamine neurodegeneration. Elucidating these neuroadaptive mechanisms could offer a path toward preserving dopamine neuron function across the lifespan and potentially preventing age-related neurodegeneration.
abstract_zh: 中脑多巴胺系统是运动、奖励和动机的核心，其功能障碍是多种脑部疾病的根源。年龄是这些疾病的主要风险因素，但对健康衰老期间多巴胺系统变化的系统性分析仍相对不足。在本综述中，我们首先考察健康衰老对多巴胺系统的影响，涵盖性别和物种差异，包括果蝇、老鼠、大鼠和人类。随后，我们探讨维持多巴胺神经元功能的神经适应机制。最后，我们对比年龄相关神经退行性疾病与健康衰老的分子机制，探讨神经适应储备的丧失是否驱动多巴胺神经退化。阐明这些神经适应机制可能为在整个生命周期内保持多巴胺神经元功能并预防年龄相关神经退行性疾病提供新途径。
